controls.button.description: Emulates a momentary or toggle button directly on the canvas, with optional external state feedback.

set.label: Set State
set.description: Optional feedback input to sync visual toggle state without re-emitting.

press.label: Press
press.description: Emits payload on button press or toggle change.

release.label: Release
release.description: Emits payload on button release in momentary mode.

buttonLabel.label: Button Text
buttonLabel.description: Caption displayed directly on the canvas button widget.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Choose between a momentary push-button and a latching on/off toggle.

payload.label: On / Press Payload
payload.description: Value emitted on press or when toggled ON. Supports string, number, and true/false.

offPayload.label: Off Payload
offPayload.description: Value emitted on release (momentary) or when toggled OFF (toggle). Supports string, number, and true/false.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: Message topic assigned to emitted button events.

controls.slider.description: Emulates an analog slider or fader directly on the canvas, with optional external feedback sync.

set.label: Set Value
set.description: External feedback input to update slider position without causing a loop.

value.label: Value
value.description: Emits the current numeric value whenever adjusted.

min.label: Min
min.description: Minimum value at the lower end of the slider range.

max.label: Max
max.description: Maximum value at the upper end of the slider range.

step.label: Step
step.description: Increment step size when dragging the slider.

defaultValue.label: Initial
defaultValue.description: Starting slider value when the flow starts.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: Display unit suffix shown on the widget and status badge (e.g. %, dB).

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: Message topic assigned to emitted slider values.

controls.vu-meter.description: Live visual audio or level meter with peak hold and optional source filtering.

sourceFilter.label: Source Filter
sourceFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against inputName or topic; non-matching messages are ignored.

min.label: Min
min.description: Input value corresponding to 0% on the meter bar.

max.label: Max
max.description: Input value corresponding to 100% on the meter bar.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: Display unit suffix used when no dB property is present.
